name: ctb_scheduler
description: One call of the CTB scheduler: the ready list and its order, the turn that is queued, the one-point tick of every eligible counter, the frame counter and the script hold.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions, only the RNG function replaced by a script; rngDraws is what the game asked for

notes: in.chrs rows are [inBattle, dead, perm, queued, ctb, baseCtb, getsTurns, tickCounter, rank, agi]; out.chrs rows are [queued, ctb, tickCounter, rank].
in.globals: scene (the value at 0xc64ca0), cmdInProgress (0x112c8d8), hold (0x112c9d1) feed the script hold; the other keys are the scheduler globals.
out.odCalls lists the characters whose turn was queued (the turn-start hook 0x7b13c0 is recorded, not run).
